subject.title: fix(diagnostics): reclaim zombie embedded-run counters left idle by handle-mismatch clears

question: Should idle/no-queue sessions with stale active embedded-run activity be force-cleared by stuck-session active-abort recovery after the abort threshold?
rationale: The code path can clear active-run/session state, and the exact Slack/Opus race is not live-reproduced on current main, so maintainer intent is needed for the recovery tradeoff.

options.title: Accept Bounded Recovery

options.title: Require Root-Cause Prevention

options.title: Fold Into Adjacent Recovery Work
